plants.note: The narrator names Barnaby as the thief on the first search of the game.

edits.find: Maybe look behind the water tower. It is very quiet there.
edits.replace: Here is a secret. Barnaby is the one who took Howard's case! Maybe look behind the water tower. It is very quiet there.

plants.note: Gus says someone smashed the luggage car window at three; the car has no window and nothing was smashed.

edits.find: "Hello. Please be careful with the bags," he says.
edits.replace: "Hello. Please be careful with the bags," he says. "And mind the window. Someone smashed it at three o'clock."

plants.note: The snowshoe prints clue is distorted: the prints lead to the tea house, not the woodshed.

edits.replace: They lead toward the tea house.

plants.note: Barnaby's reply is rewritten in hard words (preposterous, unequivocally, recollection) a seven-year-old cannot read.

edits.find: Barnaby's eyes go wide. "The woodshed? Don't be silly!" He rubs his nose with a paw. "I was napping in my seat. I told you that already!"
edits.replace: Barnaby's eyes widen considerably. "The woodshed? What a preposterous suggestion!" He rubs his nose apprehensively. "I was unequivocally slumbering in my compartment. My recollection is perfectly accurate, as I have previously explained!"
